description.en: Small bundles that extend the DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh-hans: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面加功能的独立 bundle。

description.en: Adds a compact OpenCode Go quota strip below the composer showing how much of the 5-hour, weekly, and monthly Go plan windows you have used; click it for a popover with each window's reset countdown, a refresh action, and the API key setting. The key is read from this profile's stored credential, then OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY (or OPENCODE_ZEN_GO_API_KEY / OPENCODE_API_KEY), then the local OpenCode auth.json (opencode-go entry, honoring XDG_DATA_HOME and OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT), and can be saved or cleared from the panel. The Host sends the key only to https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage, about once a minute unless you press Refresh, and the endpoint returns percentages only, so no dollar amounts are derived. Turn the plugin off to remove the strip and its channel; nothing else in DSH changes.
description.zh-hans: 在输入框下方加一条紧凑的 OpenCode Go 额度细条，显示 5 小时、本周、本月三个套餐窗口的已用比例；点击会在细条上方弹出面板，显示各窗口重置倒计时，可手动刷新和设置 API Key。Key 依次取自本 profile 保存的凭证、OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY（或 OPENCODE_ZEN_GO_API_KEY / OPENCODE_API_KEY）、本地 OpenCode 的 auth.json（opencode-go 条目，支持 XDG_DATA_HOME 与 OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT），也可以在面板里保存或清除。Host 只会把 Key 发往 https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage，约每分钟一次（手动刷新不受限）；该接口只返回百分比，因此不会推算美元金额。关闭插件即移除细条和它使用的频道，不影响 DSH 其他功能。
